63MOONS.technical: Constructive Stage 2 cup-with-handle pattern, 23.8% deep with a 10.5% handle. Price holds above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 63. Testing neckline pivot at ₹982.83.
63MOONS.fundamental: Persistent operational net losses (₹-40.4 Cr in Q2) and historical legal overhangs undermine CANSLIM criteria despite top-line expansion. Return ratios remain impaired, failing basic institutional quality screens.
63MOONS.risk: A breakdown beneath the handle low and stop at ₹886.75 invalidates the double bottom pattern.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Stage 2 breakout clearing 20-session and 52-week highs at ₹114.91. Traded cleanly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 70 indicates momentum but borders on near-term extension.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Sub-1% operating margins, thin institutional sponsorship, and unverified quarterly earnings acceleration fail O'Neil's strict C and A criteria, keeping the setup purely speculative.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A close below breakout support and the ₹104.62 stop invalidates the move; cut losses immediately.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Constructive Stage 2 base with aligned swing lows pressing the ₹513.51 neckline pivot. Moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) are sequentially aligned, and MACD confirms positive momentum.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Delivered landmark Q2 FY27 results with revenue up 27% YoY to ₹829 Cr and PAT up 83%. EBITDA margins expanded 370 bps to 16.6% via backward integration, demonstrating improving operational leverage.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Violation of swing-low support and the ₹455.37 stop compromises base structure.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook Minervini SEPA breakout to new 52-week highs past ₹1003.40 on massive 2.96x volume. Strong relative strength and clean upward alignment across EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM credentials driven by Xanthine capacity ramp and CDMO scaling. Q2 FY27 revenue grew 46% YoY to ₹610 Cr while PAT surged 156%. EBITDA margin reached 22.1% alongside low debt.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Reversal below the pivot and stop at ₹907.75 signals an institutional shakeout or failed breakout.

ABB.technical: Institutional Stage 2 leader consolidating within 1.5% of its ₹7706.70 pivot on 1.69x volume. Retains bullish moving average stacking above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with positive MACD.
ABB.fundamental: Robust institutional profile backed by a record ₹12,927 Cr order backlog (+36% YoY) and ₹7,243 Cr net cash. Q3 CY26 revenue rose 19.4% with ROCE/ROE exceeding 24%, offset by modest margin compression.
ABB.risk: Breaching base support and the 50 SMA at ₹7291.91 aborts the setup.

ABDL.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of ₹768.77 pivot on 1.45x volume. Structured in clear Stage 2 continuation above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD confirming sustained buying pressure.
ABDL.fundamental: Post-IPO operational turnaround driven by prestige-and-above premiumization. Q2 FY27 revenue rose 16% YoY to ₹1,148 Cr with PAT accelerating over 40% YoY, accompanied by steady balance sheet deleveraging.
ABDL.risk: A breakdown under base support and the ₹714.10 stop demands instant risk liquidation.
